posts.text: 🏆 I’m Finally First In The World at Something 🏆 I’m beyond proud to announce that our team placed First at the DECA International Career Development Conference! This achievement is the result of months of preparation, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. Huge thank you to my incredible teammates Nathan Yan and Alden Wang, working with you both was an inspiring experience.
